title: Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar
definition: A 19th-century polymath, educator, and social reformer who spearheaded the widow remarriage movement and revolutionized Bengali prose and education in colonial India.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Modern History (GS-I) regarding 19th-century socio-religious reform movements, women's rights, and the evolution of vernacular education.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of 19th-century Indian Renaissance
Understanding of British colonial education policies
